historicalSourceVersion: V0.17.0 beta.1 testnet preview (not relabelled V0.18)

selection.selectedRuns: all five actual-Qwen basic runs and all three actual-Qwen procurement runs from the specified final baseline
selection.selectionBias: No run chosen by success. Basic model success 4/5; procurement task failures are included.
selection.originalIntegrity: Original manifests and content-addressed identifiers refer to the original local files. Redacted files may not verify against those original manifests; this archive is an analysis derivative, not an unchanged import bundle.
selection.publicIntegrity: Verify published bytes against the repository publication-index.json. Each entry retains the exact original local SHA256 and the public SHA256.
selection.privacy: Only self-created synthetic experiments. Private ground truth is intentional research data, not user secrets. Credentials and runtime secrets are excluded; local machine/account/absolute paths are replaced.
selection.scope: Isolated EVM evidence, not public-testnet settlement. Outcomes and version fields are not rewritten.

historical-v017-preview-samples.zip.sourceHash: see original run configurations and historical/program-identity.json

namedCaseCountMeaning: Explicit names only. Repeated reports/log observations are retained; row count is not a unique-test count.
